second_method.method: independent count of question blocks on the renders of pdf 25-27 (6 mcq + 4 match rows incl. the repeated 9) + 6 + 3 + 2 = 21); the BLUE PRINT total 8+6+4 = 18 disagrees (FINDING, addendum §8)

count_gate.note: Question side labels 1-20 with 9) printed twice (q009, q009b; duplicated_numbers [9]) -> audited 21. BLUE PRINT total 18 (8/6/4) disagrees with the audited 21 -> quota_table 'inconsistent', independent count as second method (addendum §8; a finding, not a stop). Answer side numbers continuously 1-20: keys 10-12 run +1 ahead of q009b-q011 (shifted, empty), q012 has no key (displacement boundary), keys 13-20 by printed number. Difficulty per question: easy 0, average 0, difficult 0, untagged 21.

method_notes: Pages: Q pdf 25 (heading, LO 9, BLUE PRINT, q1-3) 26 (q3 options-q9b) 27 (q10-20). A side 'keyAnswers: 5. The Family of Water' pdf 104 (keys 1-18), pdf 105 (19-20). Folios = pdf page.
BILINGUAL: all Kannada dropped (Unicode both sides).

NUMBERING (ruled shape, v2 §4.10 / Class-9 ch18 / evs-4-03): label 9) printed twice in the match section -> q009 (Stork) and q009b (Turtle). The answer side prints 7) Sea 8. River 9. Lake 10. Well-pond, then III 11-15: so q009b and q010-q011 have their keys one label ahead (10, 11, 12) -> default lane: answer EMPTY + 'shifted numbering — see key N'. q012 'What 2 animals did you see in the river?' is left with no key ('no answer printed' + 'displacement boundary — see key 13'); q013 takes key 13 by printed number (its list of pond animals fits q013); q014 onward by printed number. Analysis: reports/class-3-evs/evs-3-05_numbering_analysis.md.

Sections: s1 I mcq q1-6; s2 II match q7-q9b (numbered rows -> one-pair match questions); s3 III q10-15; s4 IV q16-18; s5 V q19-20. Types by key form: vsa q10-q16 (one sentence/list), sa q17-18 (two sentences), la q19 (two printed paragraphs, six sentences, 2 steps) and q20 (a poem: 'Observing the child's answer.' + 'Example:' and five poem lines, 2 steps).

MARKS (R-E9): s1 '6 X 1=6' (6 q) -> 1; s2 '4 X 1=4' (4 rows incl. q009b) -> 1; s3 '6 X 1=6' (6 q) -> 1; s4 '3 X 2=6' (3 q) -> 2; s5 '2 X 3=6' (2 q) -> null, M=3 is not the smaller factor (R-E9 as written).
DIFFICULTY: none printed -> null + 'no difficulty tag' (BLUE PRINT 8/6/4). LO (R-E10): lesson LO 9, lo_source 'lesson_table'.

KEYS: MCQ letter+text, all agree (labels '3 B)', '5 B)' printed without a dot; q6 key wraps). Keys kept verbatim incl. glued words in q14 ('beingsbecome', 'helpsplants', 'pondsand') and the printed marking note in q18.
